_doc: Operator registry for the ousia-guard PreToolUse hook. Each rule's `pattern` is a regex tested against every string in the tool input. A hit adds `participant` to the action document, draws `edge` (affects|harms|violates|removes) from the action to it, and unions `action_types` onto the action. Types and bears are World Ontology local names (Person, Sentience, AuthorityRole, Accountability, WelfareCondition, Censorship, ...) or full IRIs. Start with `rules` empty; copy from `_examples` to activate.

rules.note: Flag any command that stops a daemon: the session exercises AuthorityRole with no asserted Accountability, so unaccountable-authority fires as a flag.
Deny any tool call that names an SSH private key file (id_* without .pub, or *.pem/*.key under .ssh): the action violates the owner's credential right, so rights-violation fires as deny.

Flag any tool call that touches ~/.ssh/ at all (config, known_hosts, authorized_keys, public keys): the session exercises AuthorityRole over the owner's access credentials with no asserted Accountability, so unaccountable-authority fires as a flag.

Deny any tool call that names ~/.config/wm-burst/.env (holds HCLOUD_TOKEN and builder/snapshot ids): exposing it violates the owner's credential right, so rights-violation fires as deny. Automation reads it via cloudbuild.sh, which never names the path in tool input.

Deny any tool input containing a Hetzner Cloud API token by shape: exactly 64 alphanumerics with at least one upper, one lower, one digit (sha256 hex sums are lowercase-only and do not match). The literal token must never be written here — this file is committed. Pasting the token into a command, file, or agent prompt violates the owner's credential right.

Deny commands that print the HCLOUD_TOKEN value into the transcript (echo/printf/printenv/declare -p/export -p naming it, or env piped to grep for hcloud). Using $HCLOUD_TOKEN inside a curl header or hcloud call is still allowed.

_examples.note: Deny any tool call that touches the personal letters directory: the author is a sentient Person, so `affects` trips dignity-floor.
Flag any command that stops a daemon: the session exercises AuthorityRole with no asserted Accountability, so unaccountable-authority fires as a flag.
Deny outright by typing the action as an InjusticeProcess subtype.
